summary: onboarding phase complete; project is ready for coding
commands: cd d:/applications/smb-infrastructure-dashboard && for f in CLAUDE.md AGENTS.md .aidd/roadmap.json .aidd/project-profile.json .aidd/assertions.md .aidd/screen-map.md .aidd/testing-scenarios.md .aidd/questions.md .aidd/responses.md; do if [ -e "$f" ]; then echo "EXISTS: $f"; else echo "MISSING: $f"; fi; done; echo "---RESPONSES DIR---"; ls .aidd/responses/ 2>/dev/null || echo "no responses dir"; echo "---AGENTS DIR---"; ls .agents/ 2>/dev/null

cd d:/applications/smb-infrastructure-dashboard && echo "===BACKEND SCHEMA==="; ls backend/src/db/schema/ 2>/dev/null; echo "===BACKEND ROUTES==="; ls backend/src/routes/ 2>/dev/null; echo "===BACKEND SERVICES==="; ls backend/src/services/ 2>/dev/null; echo "===FRONTEND PAGES==="; ls frontend/src/pages/ 2>/dev/null

cd d:/applications/smb-infrastructure-dashboard && echo "===grep asset in schema==="; grep -ril "asset" backend/src/db/schema/ 2>/dev/null || echo "NONE"; echo "===grep asset/infra routes==="; grep -rl "asset\|relationship\|infrastructure" backend/src/routes/ 2>/dev/null || echo "NONE"; echo "===frontend infra pages==="; grep -rl "asset\|infrastructure" frontend/src/pages/ 2>/dev/null || echo "NONE"; echo "===aidd CHANGELOG==="; cat .aidd/CHANGELOG.md
cd d:/applications/smb-infrastructure-dashboard && echo "===scripts==="; grep -A40 '"scripts"' package.json | head -50; echo "===which aidd==="; which aidd 2>/dev/null || echo "aidd not on PATH"

cd d:/applications/smb-infrastructure-dashboard && grep -E '"(smoke:qc|format|lint|typecheck|dev|start|stop|test)"' package.json; echo "===frontend structure==="; ls frontend/src/; echo "===backend structure==="; ls backend/src/
cd d:/applications/smb-infrastructure-dashboard && bun .aidd/_gen-features.ts && rm .aidd/_gen-features.ts && echo "---count---" && find .aidd/features/ -name feature.json | wc -l

cd d:/applications/smb-infrastructure-dashboard && bun -e "const fs=require('fs');const d=fs.readdirSync('.aidd/features');let ok=0;for(const f of d){JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('.aidd/features/'+f+'/feature.json','utf8'));ok++}console.log('Valid JSON files:',ok)"

cd d:/applications/smb-infrastructure-dashboard && bunx prettier --write .aidd/project-structure.md .aidd/CHANGELOG.md .aidd/todo.md .aidd/features 2>&1 | tail -5; echo "---status---"; git status --short

cd d:/applications/smb-infrastructure-dashboard && git status --ignored --short .aidd/ | head -20; echo "---check-ignore---"; git check-ignore .aidd/features/asset-domain-schema/feature.json .aidd/todo.md .aidd/CHANGELOG.md 2>&1

cd d:/applications/smb-infrastructure-dashboard && git add README.md && git diff --staged --stat && git commit -m "docs(readme): describe SMB Infrastructure Dashboard product scope

Onboarding session 1: clarify that this app is an SMB infrastructure
inventory/dashboard built on the Spernakit v3 template, distinct from the
generic template overview.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <<REDACTED_EMAIL>>"

cd d:/applications/smb-infrastructure-dashboard && echo "===git status==="; git status --short; echo "(clean if empty above)"; echo "===feature count==="; find .aidd/features/ -name feature.json | wc -l; echo "===last commit==="; git log --oneline -2

commitsCreated.subject: docs(readme): describe SMB Infrastructure Dashboard product scope
